provenance.paper_title: Mobile-Agent-v2: Mobile Device Operation Assistant with Effective Navigation via Multi-Agent Collaboration

evidence.paraphrase: A memory unit tracks focus content and updates it with task progress for planning and decision agents.

The fixed multi-agent workflow updates focus memory as task progress changes. For Mobile-Agent-v2, this specifically supports fixed-rule insertion or replacement of task-progress and focus-content memory.

A reflection agent observes action outcomes and repairs erroneous operations. For Mobile-Agent-v2, this specifically supports fixed-rule correction of stored state of task-progress and focus-content memory.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 4): During inference, the operative memory component (task-progress and focus-content memory) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement, fixed-rule correction of stored state; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
